description: a plate 10 x 10 x 2 with a boss of radius 2 and height 2 on its top, its axis 2.3 from the front face y = 0, so the boss stands 0.3 inside the plate's edge; the boss's root circle filleted at r 0.6. The concave ring's contact on the plate's top has radius 2.6 and leaves the top face through its front edge, which is not the blend's own, between x = 5 ± √(2.6² − 2.3²). Open CASCADE builds it with the ball rolling on that edge there: a rational patch (degree 2 across) from the boss's contact down to the edge's stretch between the two crossings, section arcs of radius r centred at r from both the boss's offset and the edge's line; the front face is untouched and the torus left either side of the patch, in two faces (V/E/F 15/24/11). Its patch is a fit 1.5e-6 off the rolled section at x = 5, so the probe tolerance is 1e-5. Arris refuses it as BlendTooLarge (the script corpus's pi mount plate's standoff roots, shrunk)
